intentComment: Story 003 — composite local Anvil dev bring-up. clean -> anvil -> deploy mocks (DeployMocks.s.sol) -> simulate yield -> extract addresses -> generate TS -> serve API. The StableStaker introduction (Story 051) rides inside deploy:local (DeployMocks Phase 3.7); simulate-yield.sh and the front-end tail do NOT touch StableStaker.

dev.command: npm run clean:local && npm run start:anvil & sleep 3 && npm run deploy:local && ./simulate-yield.sh && npm run extract:addresses && npm run generate:ts-anvil && npm run serve
dev.note: Shell precedence: `A && B & sleep 3 && C && ...` backgrounds `clean:local && start:anvil` (anvil keeps running) and foregrounds `sleep 3 && deploy:local && simulate-yield.sh && extract && generate && serve`.

chain.note: Deletes prior anvil broadcast artifacts and the progress/local deployment JSON. Forces a fresh StableStaker deploy each run (no checkpoint resume on anvil).
Backgrounded. 2s block time. Default anvil mnemonic; ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY (0xac09...ff80, anvil acct 0) is the deployer/owner.

chain.command: npm run clean:local && forge script script/DeployMocks.s.sol:DeployMocks --rpc-url http://localhost:8545 --broadcast --slow
chain.stableStakerPhase: Phase 3.7 (lines 654-685): deploy StableStaker(IFlax(phUSD), deployer); authorize as phUSD minter; per-token (DOLA, USDC, USDe) addToken + strategy.setClient(staker,true) + staker.setYieldStrategy + staker.phUSDPerDay. DOLA/USDe = 10e18/day, USDC = 5e18/day.
chain.note: THE step that deploys + wires StableStaker. Re-runs clean:local internally. --slow for anvil ordering. Reads ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY via vm.envUint. Writes server/deployments/progress.31337.json (vm.writeFile, DeployMocks._writeProgressFile line 1196-1222).

chain.command: cast send MockDola mint(MockAutoDOLA, 2300e18) ; reads MockDola/MockAutoDOLA from progress.31337.json
chain.note: OUT OF STABLE-STAKER SCOPE. Mints 2300 DOLA directly into the MockAutoDOLA vault to inflate totalAssets() (fake yield) for the StableYieldAccumulator/Phlimbo path. Does NOT reference or touch StableStaker, its pools, or its DOLA yield-strategy client wiring.
Reads server/deployments/progress.31337.json, flattens .contracts.* (incl. StableStaker) into server/deployments/local.json.
Emits server/deployments/addresses.ts (interface incl. `StableStaker: string` field, line 44) + local-addresses.ts for the front-end.
Express API on :3001 serving the deployment JSON (incl. StableStaker address). No state mutation.
